title: Team SMP
description: Just another survival server, with skills, teams, economy, RTP and vein mining.
body:
The [Team SMP](https://www.teamsmp.uk/) is a survival Minecraft server run by [JunglTemple](https://modrinth.com/user/JunglTemple) and XxDreamXxXx, featuring features like skills, teams, economy, RTP, custom terrain generation thanks to [Terralith](https://modrinth.com/datapack/terralith) and vein mining.

**The Survival world is currently not available, as we re resetting it and upgrading it to Minecraft 26.1.**

It is recommended to play on the Team SMP using the [Team SMP++ modpack](https://modrinth.com/teamsmp++), but this is completely optional.

This is a small server. But I decided to put it on here anyway, because who knows, maybe there will be someone who wants to join. If you do decide to join, don't expect there to be other people online.
